products.sectionDescription: Liquid + powder sweeteners, cooking aids, low-cal jams, and low-cal candies. Every item is designed around 'low-cal + no added sugar'.

teaser.eyebrow: The full HABA AI commerce loop
teaser.title: 3 storylines from HABA AI commerce
teaser.description: Each card opens its own page: an 8-step AI Token auto top-up animation, HABA reselling AI capacity by call volume to partners, and 4 B2B embedding modes.

topup.title: Low balance? The SDK refills it
topup.desc: When HABA AI Advisor's Token balance dips below threshold, the SDK auto-pays a USDC micro-payment to refill — credited in seconds. Wallet signs client-side; HABA's server never holds the key.

resale.title: HABA AI Advisor resale
resale.desc: HABA packages the AI Advisor by monthly call volume and sells to pharmacies, hospitals, dietitians, and EC partners. Partners consume HABA's own Token quota.

b2b.title: 4 personas · 4 embed forms
b2b.desc: Pharmacy SDK, hospital API, dietitian MCP, EC web widget — the same Advisor wearing 4 different skins.

topup.sectionTitle: How a USDC micro-payment flows into a Token credit
topup.sectionDescription: When HABA AI Advisor's Token balance dips below threshold, the SDK fires a 10,000-Token purchase. The 8 steps below auto-advance; click a row to pause and inspect.
topup.flowTitle: 8 steps · from order to Token credit
topup.flowSubtitle: Advances every 1.6s; click a row to pause / pick
topup.noteAutopilotBody: The SDK kicks off when balance drops below threshold. Zero human intervention from HABA ops.
topup.noteNoKeyTitle: Client-side signed · HABA never holds the private key
topup.noteNoKeyBody: Wallet signing happens entirely in the browser; HABA's server only sees an already-signed USDC tx.
topup.noteWebhookBody: When Token lands, HABA AI Advisor resumes B2B / C-end calls immediately — invisible to end users.

resale.description: HABA packages the AI Advisor by monthly call volume and sells to pharmacies, hospitals, dietitians, and EC partners. Partners pre-pay a Token quota by usage; HABA handles metering and reconciliation automatically.
resale.plansSubtitle: Priced per monthly Token quota; overage at unit price. Real contract prices set per commercial conversation.

b2b.sectionTitle: Same HABA AI Advisor · 4 embedding modes
b2b.sectionDescription: Click any persona to see how it actually calls HABA AI Advisor (prompt + Advisor output). Every call counts toward HABA's monthly Token plan.
